sections.label: Book 9
sections.name: The Vajapeya (draught of strength) and the Rajasuya

verses.sa: देव सवितः प्रसुव यज्ञं प्रसुव यज्ञपतिं भगाय। दिव्यो गन्धर्वः केतुपूः केतं नः पुनातु वाचस्पतिर्वाजं नः स्वदतु स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: deva savitaḥ prasuva yajñaṃ prasuva yajñapatiṃ bhagāya divyo gandharvaḥ ketupūḥ ketaṃ naḥ punātu vācaspatirvājaṃ naḥ svadatu svāhā
verses.en: Our sacrifice, God Savitar, speed onward: speed to his share the sacrifice's patron. May the celestial Gandharva, cleanser of thought and will, make clean our thought and purpose: the Lord of Speech sweeten the food we offer.

verses.sa: ध्रुवसदं त्वा नृषदं मनःसदमुपयामगृहीतोऽसीन्द्राय त्वा जुष्टं गृह्णाम्येष ते योनिरिन्द्राय त्वा जुष्टतमम्। अप्सुषदं त्वा घृतसदं व्योमसदमुपयामगृहीतोऽसीन्द्राय त्वा जुष्टं गृह्णाम्येष ते योनिरिन्द्राय त्वा जुष्टतमम्। पृथिवीसदं त्वाऽन्तरिक्षसदं दिविसदं देवसदं नाकसदमुपयामगृहीतोऽसीन्द्राय त्वा जुष्टं गृह्णाम्येष ते योनिरिन्द्राय त्वा जुष्टतमम्॥
verses.tr: dhruvasadaṃ tvā nṛṣadaṃ manaḥsadamupayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmyeṣa te yonirindrāya tvā juṣṭatamam apsuṣadaṃ tvā ghṛtasadaṃ vyomasadamupayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmyeṣa te yonirindrāya tvā juṣṭatamam pṛthivīsadaṃ tvā'ntarikṣasadaṃ divisadaṃ devasadaṃ nākasadamupayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmyeṣa te yonirindrāya tvā juṣṭatamam
verses.en: Thee, firmly set, settled in man, in spirit. Taken upon a base art thou. I take thee, draught acceptable to Indra. This is thy home. Thee, welcomest to Indra, Thee set in waters, butter, realm of ether. Taken upon Indra. Thee seated in the sky, earth, air's mid-region, among the Gods and in the vault of heaven. Taken, etc. as above.

verses.sa: अपां रसमुद्वयसं सूर्ये सन्तं समाहितम्। अपां रसस्य यो रसस्तं वो गृह्णाम्युत्तममुपयामगृहीतो सीन्द्राय त्वा जुष्टं गृह्णाम्येष ते योनिरिन्द्राय त्वा जुष्टतमम्॥
verses.tr: apāṃ rasamudvayasaṃ sūrye santaṃ samāhitam apāṃ rasasya yo rasastaṃ vo gṛhṇāmyuttamamupayāmagṛhīto sīndrāya tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmyeṣa te yonirindrāya tvā juṣṭatamam
verses.en: The strength-arousing essence of the waters, gathered in the Sun, Essence of waters' essence, that, most excellent, I take for you. Taken, etc., as above.

verses.sa: ग्रहा ऊर्जाहुतयो व्यन्तो विप्राय मतिम्। तेषां विशिप्रियाणां वोऽहमिषमूर्जं समग्रभमुपयामगृहीतोऽसीन्द्राय त्वा जुष्टं गृह्णाम्येष ते योनिरिन्द्राय त्वा जुष्टतमम्। सम्पृचौ स्थः सं मा भद्रेण पृङ्क्तं विपृचौ स्थो वि मा पाप्मना पृङ्क्तम्॥
verses.tr: grahā ūrjāhutayo vyanto viprāya matim teṣāṃ viśipriyāṇāṃ vo'hamiṣamūrjaṃ samagrabhamupayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmyeṣa te yonirindrāya tvā juṣṭatamam sampṛcau sthaḥ saṃ mā bhadreṇa pṛṅktaṃ vipṛcau stho vi mā pāpmanā pṛṅktam
verses.en: Cups of strength-giving sacrifice, inspirers of the sage's hymn—Of you, the handleless, have I collected all the sap and strength. Taken, etc., as above. United are ye twain: with bliss unite me. Parted are ye: keep me apart from evil.

verses.sa: इन्द्रस्य वज्रोऽसि वाजसास्त्वयायं वाजं सेत्। वाजस्य नु प्रसवे मातरं महीमदितिं नाम वचसा करामहे। यस्यामिदं विश्वं भुवनमाविवेश तस्यां नो देवः सविता धर्म साविषत्॥
verses.tr: indrasya vajro'si vājasāstvayāyaṃ vājaṃ set vājasya nu prasave mātaraṃ mahīmaditiṃ nāma vacasā karāmahe yasyāmidaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanamāviveśa tasyāṃ no devaḥ savitā dharma sāviṣat
verses.en: Thou art the thunderbolt of Indra, winner of wealth: with thee may this man win him riches. In gain of wealth we celebrate with praises her, Aditi by name, the Mighty Mother, On whom this Universe of life hath settled. Thereon God Savitar promote our dwelling!

verses.sa: अप्स्वन्तरमृतमप्सु भेषजमपामुत प्रशस्तिष्वश्वा भवत वाजिनः। देवीरापो यो व ऊर्मिः प्रतूर्तिः ककुन्मान् वाजसास्तेनायं वाजं सेत्॥
verses.tr: apsvantaramṛtamapsu bheṣajamapāmuta praśastiṣvaśvā bhavata vājinaḥ devīrāpo yo va ūrmiḥ pratūrtiḥ kakunmān vājasāstenāyaṃ vājaṃ set
verses.en: Amrit is in the Waters, in the Waters healing medicine. Yea, Horses! at our praises of the Waters grow ye fleet and strong. Whatever wave, O ye celestial Waters, wealth-giving, towering high, and swiftly rushing, is yours, therewith may this man win him riches.

verses.sa: वातो वा मनो वा गन्धर्वाः सप्तविंशतिः। ते अग्रेऽश्वमयुञ्जँस्ते अस्मिञ्जवमा दधुः॥
verses.tr: vāto vā mano vā gandharvāḥ saptaviṃśatiḥ te agre'śvamayuñjaṃste asmiñjavamā dadhuḥ
verses.en: It was the wind, or it was thought, or the Gandharvas twenty-seven—These at the first harnessed the horse: they set the power of speed in him.

verses.sa: वातरंहा भव वाजिन्युज्यमान इन्द्रस्येव दक्षिणः श्रियैधि। युञ्जन्तु त्वा मरुतो विश्ववेदस आ ते त्वष्टा पत्सु जवं दधातु॥
verses.tr: vātaraṃhā bhava vājinyujyamāna indrasyeva dakṣiṇaḥ śriyaidhi yuñjantu tvā maruto viśvavedasa ā te tvaṣṭā patsu javaṃ dadhātu
verses.en: Steed, being yoked grow wind swift: be beauteous as Indra's right-hand steed; Omniscient Maruts harness thee! Tvashtar put swiftness in thy feet!

verses.sa: जवो यस्ते वाजिन्निहितो गुहा यः श्येने परीत्तो अचरच्च वाते। तेन नो वाजिन् वलवान् बलेन वाजजिच्च भव समने च पारयिष्णुः। वाजिनो वाजजितो वाजं सरिष्यन्तो बृहस्पतेर्भागमवजिघ्रत॥
verses.tr: javo yaste vājinnihito guhā yaḥ śyene parītto acaracca vāte tena no vājin valavān balena vājajicca bhava samane ca pārayiṣṇuḥ vājino vājajito vājaṃ sariṣyanto bṛhaspaterbhāgamavajighrata
verses.en: What speed, O Horse, was laid in thee in secret, what passed in wind, bestowed upon the falcon. With that same strength be strong for us, O Courser, wealth-winning and victorious in battle. Starting to run your course, winners of riches, smell ye Brihaspati's portion, O ye Horses.

verses.sa: देवस्याहं सवितुः सवे सत्यसवसो बृहस्पतेरुत्तमं नाकं रुहेयम्। देवस्याहं सवितुः सवे सत्यसवस इन्द्रस्योत्तमं नाकं रुहेयम्। देवस्याहं सवितुः सवे सत्यप्रसवसो बृहस्पतेरुत्तमं नाकमरुहम्। देवस्याहं सवितुः सवे सत्यप्रसवस इन्द्रस्योत्तमं नाकमरुहम्॥
verses.tr: devasyāhaṃ savituḥ save satyasavaso bṛhaspateruttamaṃ nākaṃ ruheyam devasyāhaṃ savituḥ save satyasavasa indrasyottamaṃ nākaṃ ruheyam devasyāhaṃ savituḥ save satyaprasavaso bṛhaspateruttamaṃ nākamaruham devasyāhaṃ savituḥ save satyaprasavasa indrasyottamaṃ nākamaruham
verses.en: By impulse of God Savitar, true Impeller, may I ascend 't. Brihaspati's highest heaven. By impulse of God Savitar, true Impeller, may I ascend the highest heaven of Indra. By impulse of God Savitar, true Impeller, Brihaspati's highest heaven have I ascended. By impulse of God Savitar, true Impeller, I have ascended Indra's loftiest heaven.

verses.sa: बृहस्पते वाजं जय बृहस्पतये वाचं वदत बृहस्पतिं वाजं जापयत। इन्द्र वाजं जयेन्द्राय वाचं वदतेन्द्रं वाजं जापयत॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspate vājaṃ jaya bṛhaspataye vācaṃ vadata bṛhaspatiṃ vājaṃ jāpayata indra vājaṃ jayendrāya vācaṃ vadatendraṃ vājaṃ jāpayata
verses.en: Brihaspati, win the prize. Lift up your voices to Brihaspati. Make ye Brihaspati win the prize. Do thou, O Indra, win the prize. To Indra lift your voices up. Make Indra winner of the prize.

verses.sa: एषा वः सा सत्या संवागभूद्यया बृहस्पतिं वाजमजीजपताजीजपत बृहस्पतिं वाजं वनस्पतयो विमुच्यध्वम्। एषा वः सा सत्या संवागभूद्ययेन्द्रं वाजमजीजपताजीजपतेन्द्रं वाजं वनस्पतयो विमुच्यध्वम्॥
verses.tr: eṣā vaḥ sā satyā saṃvāgabhūdyayā bṛhaspatiṃ vājamajījapatājījapata bṛhaspatiṃ vājaṃ vanaspatayo vimucyadhvam eṣā vaḥ sā satyā saṃvāgabhūdyayendraṃ vājamajījapatājījapatendraṃ vājaṃ vanaspatayo vimucyadhvam
verses.en: True hath, been this your league whereby ye made Brihaspati win the prize. Brihaspati have ye caused to win the prize. Be freed, ye Forest-lords. Faithful was this your league whereby ye have made Indra win the prize. Ye have made Indra win the prize. Be ye set free, ye Forest-lords.

verses.sa: देवस्याहं सवितुः सवे सत्यप्रसवसो बृहस्पतेर्वाजजितो वाजं जेषम्। वाजिनो वाजजितोऽध्वन स्कभ्नुवन्तो योजना मिमानाः काष्ठां गच्छत॥
verses.tr: devasyāhaṃ savituḥ save satyaprasavaso bṛhaspatervājajito vājaṃ jeṣam vājino vājajito'dhvana skabhnuvanto yojanā mimānāḥ kāṣṭhāṃ gacchata
verses.en: Through impulse of God Savitar, true Impeller, mine be Brihaspati's prize who winneth prizes. On to the goal, ye Steeds, winners of prizes, blocking the ways and meting out the courses!

verses.sa: एष स्य वाजी क्षिपणिं तुरण्यति ग्रीवायां बद्धो अपिकक्ष आसनि। क्रतुं दधिक्रा अनु संसनिष्यदत्पथामङ्कांस्यन्वापनीपणत् स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: eṣa sya vājī kṣipaṇiṃ turaṇyati grīvāyāṃ baddho apikakṣa āsani kratuṃ dadhikrā anu saṃsaniṣyadatpathāmaṅkāṃsyanvāpanīpaṇat svāhā
verses.en: \i Bound by the neck and at the flanks and in the mouth, that vigorous Courser lends new swiftness to his speed. Drawing himself together as his strength allows, Dadhikr's speeds along the windings of the paths. All-hail!

verses.sa: उत स्मास्य द्रुवतस्तुरण्यतः पर्णं न वेरनुवाति प्रगर्धिनः। श्येनस्येव ध्रजतो अङ्कसं परि दधिक्राव्णः सहोर्जा तरित्रतः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: uta smāsya druvatasturaṇyataḥ parṇaṃ na veranuvāti pragardhinaḥ śyenasyeva dhrajato aṅkasaṃ pari dadhikrāvṇaḥ sahorjā taritrataḥ svāhā
verses.en: His pinion, rapid runner, fans him on his way, as of a bird that hastens onward to its aim, And, as it were a falcon's gliding through the air, strikes Dadhikravan's side as he speeds on with might. All-hail!

verses.sa: शं नो भवन्तु वाजिनो हवेषु देवताता मितद्रवः स्वर्काः। जम्भयन्तोऽहिं वृकं रक्षासि सनेम्यस्मद्युयवन्नमीवाः॥
verses.tr: śaṃ no bhavantu vājino haveṣu devatātā mitadravaḥ svarkāḥ jambhayanto'hiṃ vṛkaṃ rakṣāsi sanemyasmadyuyavannamīvāḥ
verses.en: Bless us the Coursers when we call, while slowly they move, strong singers, to the Gods' assembly. Crushing the wolf, the serpent, and the demons, may they completely banish all affliction. All-hail!

verses.sa: ते नो अर्वन्तो हवनश्रुतो हवं विश्वे शृण्वन्तु वाजिनो मितद्रवः। सहस्रसा मेधसाता सनिष्यवो महो ये धनं समिथेषु जभ्रिरे॥
verses.tr: te no arvanto havanaśruto havaṃ viśve śṛṇvantu vājino mitadravaḥ sahasrasā medhasātā saniṣyavo maho ye dhanaṃ samitheṣu jabhrire
verses.en: May all those vigorous Coursers listen to our cry, hearers of invocation, speeders on their way; Winners of thousands, fain to win where meed is won, who gather of themselves great wealth in every race.

verses.sa: वाजे-वाजेऽवत वाजिनो नो धनेषु विप्रा अमृता ऋतज्ञाः। अस्य मध्वः पिबत मादयध्वं तृप्ता यात पथिभिर्देवयानैः॥
verses.tr: vāje-vāje'vata vājino no dhaneṣu viprā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ asya madhvaḥ pibata mādayadhvaṃ tṛptā yāta pathibhirdevayānaiḥ
verses.en: Deep-skilled in Law Eternal, wise, immortal, O Coursers, help us in each fray for booty. Drink of this meath, be satisfied, be joyful: then go on paths which Gods are wont to travel.

verses.sa: आ मा वाजस्य प्रसवो जगम्यादेमे द्यावापृथिवी विश्वरूपे। आ मा गन्तां पितरा मातरा चा मा सोमो अमृतत्वेन गम्यात्। वाजिनो वाजजितो वाजं ससृवांसो बृहस्पतेर्भागमवजिघ्रत निमृजानाः॥
verses.tr: ā mā vājasya prasavo jagamyādeme dyāvāpṛthivī viśvarūpe ā mā gantāṃ pitarā mātarā cā mā somo amṛtatvena gamyāt vājino vājajito vājaṃ sasṛvāṃso bṛhaspaterbhāgamavajighrata nimṛjānāḥ
verses.en: To me come plenteous growth of wealth! Approach me these, Heaven and Earth, who wear each form and figure! Hither may Father come to me, and Mother. Soma with immortality approach me!

verses.sa: आपये स्वाहा स्वापये स्वाहा ऽपिजाय स्वाहा क्रतवे स्वाहा वसवे स्वाहा ऽहर्पतये स्वाहा ऽह्ने मुग्धाय स्वाहा मुग्धाय वैनंशिनाय स्वाहा विनंशिन आन्त्यायनाय स्वाहा ऽन्त्याय भौवनाय स्वाहा भुवनस्य पतये स्वाहाऽधिपतये स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: āpaye svāhā svāpaye svāhā 'pijāya svāhā kratave svāhā vasave svāhā 'harpataye svāhā 'hne mugdhāya svāhā mugdhāya vainaṃśināya svāhā vinaṃśina āntyāyanāya svāhā 'ntyāya bhauvanāya svāhā bhuvanasya pataye svāhā'dhipataye svāhā
verses.en: To the Friend, Hail! To the Good Friend, Hail! To the Later-born, Hail! To Resolution, Hail! To the Vasu, Hail! To the Lord of Days, Hail! To the Failing Day, Hail! To the Failing sprung from the Transitory, Hail! To the Transitory sprung from the Final, Hail! To the Final Mundane, Hail! To the Lord of the World, Hail! To the Sovran Lord, Hail!

verses.sa: आयुर्यज्ञेन कल्पतां प्राणो यज्ञेन कल्पतां चक्षुर्यज्ञेन कल्पतातांं श्रोत्रं यज्ञेन कल्पतां पृष्ठं यज्ञेन कल्पतां यज्ञो यज्ञेन कल्पताम्। प्रजापतेः प्रजा अभूम स्वर्देवा अगन्मामृता अभूम॥
verses.tr: āyuryajñena kalpatāṃ prāṇo yajñena kalpatāṃ cakṣuryajñena kalpatātāṃṃ śrotraṃ yajñena kalpatāṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ yajñena kalpatāṃ yajño yajñena kalpatām prajāpateḥ prajā abhūma svardevā aganmāmṛtā abhūma
verses.en: May life succeed through sacrifice. May life-breath thrive by sacrifice. May the eye thrive by sacrifice. May the ear thrive by sacrifice. May the back thrive by sacrifice. May sacrifice thrive by sacrifice. We have become the children of Prajapati. Gods, we have gone to heaven. We have become immortal.

verses.sa: अस्मे वो अस्त्विन्द्रियमस्मे नृम्णमुत क्रतुरस्मे वर्चांसि सन्तु वः। नमो मात्रे पृथिव्यै नमो मात्रे पृथिव्या इयं ते राड् यन्ताऽसि यमनो ध्रुवोऽसि धरुणः। कृष्यै त्वा क्षेमाय त्वा रय्यै त्वा पोषाय त्वा॥
verses.tr: asme vo astvindriyamasme nṛmṇamuta kraturasme varcāṃsi santu vaḥ namo mātre pṛthivyai namo mātre pṛthivyā iyaṃ te rāḍ yantā'si yamano dhruvo'si dharuṇaḥ kṛṣyai tvā kṣemāya tvā rayyai tvā poṣāya tvā
verses.en: In us be your great might and manly vigour, in us be your intelligence and splendour. Obeisance to our Mother Earth! Obeisance to our Mother Earthy! This is thy Sovranty. Thou art the ruler, thou art controller, thou art firm and stedfast. Thee for land-culture, thee for peace and quiet, thee for wealth, thee for increase of our substance.

verses.sa: वाजस्येमं प्रसवः सुषुवेऽग्रे सोमं राजानमोषधीष्वप्सु। ता अस्मभ्यं मधुमतीर्भवन्तु वयं राष्ट्रे जागृयाम पुरोहिताः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: vājasyemaṃ prasavaḥ suṣuve'gre somaṃ rājānamoṣadhīṣvapsu tā asmabhyaṃ madhumatīrbhavantu vayaṃ rāṣṭre jāgṛyāma purohitāḥ svāhā
verses.en: Of old the furtherance of strength urged onward this Sovran Soma in the plants and waters. For us may they be stored with honey: stationed in front may we be watchful in the kingdom. All-hail!

verses.sa: वाजस्येमां प्रसवः शिश्रिये दिवमिमा च विश्वा भुवनानि सम्राट्। अदित्सन्तं दापयति प्रजानन्त्स नो रयिं सर्ववीरं नि यच्छतु स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: vājasyemāṃ prasavaḥ śiśriye divamimā ca viśvā bhuvanāni samrāṭ aditsantaṃ dāpayati prajānantsa no rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ ni yacchatu svāhā
verses.en: The furtherance of strength extended over this heaven and all the worlds as sovran ruler. He, knowing, makes the churl a bounteous giver: wealth may he grant us with full store of heroes. All-hail!

verses.sa: वाजस्य नु प्रसव आ बभूवेमा च विश्वा भुवनानि सर्वतः। सनेमि राजा परि याति विद्वान् प्रजां पुष्टिं वर्धयमानो अस्मे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: vājasya nu prasava ā babhūvemā ca viśvā bhuvanāni sarvataḥ sanemi rājā pari yāti vidvān prajāṃ puṣṭiṃ vardhayamāno asme svāhā
verses.en: Surely the furtherance of strength pervaded all these existing worlds in all directions. From olden time the King moves round, well knowing, strengthening all the people and our welfare.

verses.sa: सोमं राजानमवसेऽग्निमन्वारभामहे। आदित्यान्विष्णुं सूर्यं ब्रह्माणं च बृहस्पतिं स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: somaṃ rājānamavase'gnimanvārabhāmahe ādityānviṣṇuṃ sūryaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca bṛhaspatiṃ svāhā
verses.en: As suppliants, for aid we grasp Soma the King, and Agni, the Adityas, Vishnu, Surya, and the Brahman-priest Brihaspati.

verses.sa: अर्यमणं बृहस्पतिमिन्द्रं दानाय चोदय। वाचं विष्णुं सरस्वतीं सवितारं च वाजिनं स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: aryamaṇaṃ bṛhaspatimindraṃ dānāya codaya vācaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarasvatīṃ savitāraṃ ca vājinaṃ svāhā
verses.en: Urge Aryaman to send us gifts, and Indra, and Brihaspati, Yak, Vishnu, and Sarasvati, and the strong Courser Savitar.

verses.sa: अग्ने अच्छा वदेह नः प्रति नः सुमना भव। प्र नो यच्छ सहस्रजित्त्वं हि धनदा असि स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: agne acchā vadeha naḥ prati naḥ sumanā bhava pra no yaccha sahasrajittvaṃ hi dhanadā asi svāhā
verses.en: Agni, speak kindly to us here, be graciously inclined to us. Winner of thousands, grant us boons, for thou art he who giveth wealth.

verses.sa: प्र नो यच्छत्वर्यमा प्र पूषा प्र बृहस्पतिः। प्र वाग्देवी ददातु नः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: pra no yacchatvaryamā pra pūṣā pra bṛhaspatiḥ pra vāgdevī dadātu naḥ svāhā
verses.en: Let Aryaman vouchsafe us wealth, and Pushan, and Brihaspati. May VAk the Goddess give to us. All-hail!

verses.sa: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवेऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम्। सरस्वत्यै वाचो यन्तुर्यन्त्रिये दधामि बृहस्पतेष्ट्वा साम्राज्येनाभि षिञ्चाम्यसौ॥
verses.tr: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām sarasvatyai vāco yanturyantriye dadhāmi bṛhaspateṣṭvā sāmrājyenābhi ṣiñcāmyasau
verses.en: Thee by the radiant Savitar's impulsion, with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pushan. To Vak Sarasvati's controlling guidance, hers the controlling leader, I consign thee. I with Brihaspati's supreme dominion endow thee by the balm of consecration.

verses.sa: अग्निरेकाक्षरेण प्राणमुदजयत्तमुज्जेषमश्विनौ द्व्यक्षरेण द्विपदो मनुष्यानुदजयतां तानुज्जेषं विष्णुस्त्र्यक्षरेण त्रीँल्लोकानुदजयत्तानुज्जेषंं सोमश्चतुरक्षरेण चतुष्पदः पशूनुदजयत्तानुज्जेषम्॥
verses.tr: agnirekākṣareṇa prāṇamudajayattamujjeṣamaśvinau dvyakṣareṇa dvipado manuṣyānudajayatāṃ tānujjeṣaṃ viṣṇustryakṣareṇa trīṃllokānudajayattānujjeṣaṃṃ somaścaturakṣareṇa catuṣpadaḥ paśūnudajayattānujjeṣam
verses.en: With the monosyllable Agni won vital breath: may I win that. With the dissyllable the Asvins won bipeds: may I win those. With the trisyllable. Vishnu won the three worlds: may I win those. With quadrisyllable metre Soma won four-footed cattle: may I win those.

verses.sa: पूषा पञ्चाक्षरेण पञ्च दिश उदजयत्ता उज्जेषंं सविता षडक्षरेण षडृतूनुदजयत्तानुज्जेषं मरुतः सप्ताक्षरेण सप्त ग्राम्यान् पशूनुदजयँस्तानुज्जेषं बृहस्पतिरष्टाक्षरेण गायत्रीमुदजयत्तामुज्जेषम्॥
verses.tr: pūṣā pañcākṣareṇa pañca diśa udajayattā ujjeṣaṃṃ savitā ṣaḍakṣareṇa ṣaḍṛtūnudajayattānujjeṣaṃ marutaḥ saptākṣareṇa sapta grāmyān paśūnudajayaṃstānujjeṣaṃ bṛhaspatiraṣṭākṣareṇa gāyatrīmudajayattāmujjeṣam
verses.en: With five-syllable metre Pushan won the five regions: may I win them. With six-syllable metre Savitar won the six seasons: may I win them. With seven-syllable metre the Maruts won the seven domestic animals: May I win them. With octosyllabic metre Brihaspati won the Gayatri!: may I win that.

verses.sa: मित्रो नवाक्षरेण त्रिवृतं स्तोममुदजयत्तमुज्जेषं वरुणो दशाक्षरेण विराजमुदजयत्तामुज्जेषमिन्द्र एकादशाक्षरेण त्रिष्टुभमुदजयत्तामुज्जेषं विश्वे देवा द्वादशाक्षरेण जगतीमुदजयँस्तामुज्जेषम्॥
verses.tr: mitro navākṣareṇa trivṛtaṃ stomamudajayattamujjeṣaṃ varuṇo daśākṣareṇa virājamudajayattāmujjeṣamindra ekādaśākṣareṇa triṣṭubhamudajayattāmujjeṣaṃ viśve devā dvādaśākṣareṇa jagatīmudajayaṃstāmujjeṣam
verses.en: With nine-syllable metre Mitra won the Trivrit Soma: may I win that. With decasyllabic metre Varuna won Viraj: may! Win that. With hendecasjrllabic metre Indra won Trishtup: may I win that. With dodecasyllabic metre the All-Gods won Jagati: may I win that.

verses.sa: वसवस्त्रयोदशाक्षरेण त्रयोदशं स्तोममुदजयँस्तमुज्जेषंं रुद्राश्चतुर्दशाक्षरेण चतुर्दशं स्तोममुदजयँस्तमुज्जेषमादित्याः पञ्चदशाक्षरेण पञ्चदशं स्तोममुदजयँस्तमुज्जेषमदितिः षोडशाक्षरेण षोडशं स्तोममुदजयत्तमुज्जेषं प्रजापतिः सप्तदशाक्षरेण सप्तदशं स्तोममुदजयत्तमुज्जेषम्॥
verses.tr: vasavastrayodaśākṣareṇa trayodaśaṃ stomamudajayaṃstamujjeṣaṃṃ rudrāścaturdaśākṣareṇa caturdaśaṃ stomamudajayaṃstamujjeṣamādityāḥ pañcadaśākṣareṇa pañcadaśaṃ stomamudajayaṃstamujjeṣamaditiḥ ṣoḍaśākṣareṇa ṣoḍaśaṃ stomamudajayattamujjeṣaṃ prajāpatiḥ saptadaśākṣareṇa saptadaśaṃ stomamudajayattamujjeṣam
verses.en: The Vasus by thirteen-syllable metre won the Thirteenfold Soma: may I win that. The Rudras by fourteen-syllable liable metre won the fourteenfold Soma: may I win that. The Adityas with fifteen-syllable metre won the Fifteenfold Soma: may I win that. Aditi with sixteen-syllable metre won the Sixteenfold Soma: may I win that. Prajapati with seventeenfold metre won the Seventeenfold Soma: may I win that.

verses.sa: एष ते निरृते भागस्तं जुषस्व स्वाहाऽग्निनेत्रेभ्यो देवेभ्यः पुरः सद्भ्यः स्वाहा यमनेत्रेभ्यो देवेभ्यो दक्षिणासद्भ्यः स्वाहा विश्वदेवनेत्रेभ्यो देवेभ्यः पश्चात्सद्भ्यः स्वाहा मित्रावरुणनेत्रेभ्यो वा मरुन्नेत्रेभ्यो वा देवेभ्य उत्तरासद्भ्यः स्वाहा सोमनेत्रेभ्यो देवेभ्य उपरिसद्भ्यो दुवस्वद्भ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: eṣa te nirṛte bhāgastaṃ juṣasva svāhā'gninetrebhyo devebhyaḥ puraḥ sadbhyaḥ svāhā yamanetrebhyo devebhyo dakṣiṇāsadbhyaḥ svāhā viśvadevanetrebhyo devebhyaḥ paścātsadbhyaḥ svāhā mitrāvaruṇanetrebhyo vā marunnetrebhyo vā devebhya uttarāsadbhyaḥ svāhā somanetrebhyo devebhya uparisadbhyo duvasvadbhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: This is thy portion, Nirriti! Accept it graciously. All-hail! To Gods whose guide is Agni, to the eastward-seated Gods, All-hail!, To Gods whose guide is Yama, to the southward-seated Gods, All-hail! To Gods whose guides are the All-Gods, those who are seated westward. Hail! Hail to the northward-seated Gods, to those whose guides are Mitra and Varuna or the Marut host! To Gods whose guide is Soma, who, worshipful, sit on high. All-hail!

verses.sa: ये देवा अग्निनेत्राः पुरः सदस्तेभ्यः स्वाहा ये देवा यमनेत्रा दक्षिणासदस्तेभ्यः स्वाहा ये देवा विश्वदेवनेत्राः पश्चात्सदस्तेभ्यः स्वाहा ये देवा मित्रावरुणनेत्रा वा मरुन्नेत्रा वोत्तरासदस्तेभ्यः स्वाहा ये देवाः सोमनेत्रा उपरिसदो दुवस्वन्तस्तेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ye devā agninetrāḥ puraḥ sadastebhyaḥ svāhā ye devā yamanetrā dakṣiṇāsadastebhyaḥ svāhā ye devā viśvadevanetrāḥ paścātsadastebhyaḥ svāhā ye devā mitrāvaruṇanetrā vā marunnetrā vottarāsadastebhyaḥ svāhā ye devāḥ somanetrā uparisado duvasvantastebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Gods who have Agni as their guide, whose seat is eastward, Hail to them! Gods who have Yama as their guide, whose seat is southward. Hail to them! Gods who have All-Gods as their guideS whose seat is westward. Hail to them! Gods who have Mitra-Yarazia for guides, north-seated. Hail to them! Gods who have Soma as their guide, high-seated, worshipful, Hail to them!

verses.sa: अग्ने सहस्व पृतना अभिमातीरपास्य। दुष्टरस्तरन्नरातीर्वर्चो धा यज्ञवाहसि॥
verses.tr: agne sahasva pṛtanā abhimātīrapāsya duṣṭarastarannarātīrvarco dhā yajñavāhasi
verses.en: Agni, subdue opposing bands and drive our enemies away. Invincible, slay godless foes; give splendour to the worshipper.

verses.sa: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवेऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम्। उपांशोर्वीर्येण जुहोमि हतं रक्षः स्वाहा रक्षसां त्वा बधायाबधिष्म रक्षोऽबधिष्मामुमसौ हतः॥
verses.tr: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām upāṃśorvīryeṇa juhomi hataṃ rakṣaḥ svāhā rakṣasāṃ tvā badhāyābadhiṣma rakṣo'badhiṣmāmumasau hataḥ
verses.en: Thee at the radiant Savitar's impulsion, with Asvins' arms and with the hands of Pushan, I offer with the strength of the Upamsu. Slain is the demon brood. All-hail! Thee for the slaughter of the brood of demons. The demons have we slain, have slain. So-and-So, Soaand-So is slain.

verses.sa: सविता त्वा सवानां सुवतामग्निर्गृहपतीनां सोमो वनस्पतीनाम्। बृहस्पतिर्वाच इन्द्रो ज्यैष्ठ्याय रुद्रः पशुभ्यो मित्रः सत्यो वरुणो धर्मपतीनाम्॥
verses.tr: savitā tvā savānāṃ suvatāmagnirgṛhapatīnāṃ somo vanaspatīnām bṛhaspatirvāca indro jyaiṣṭhyāya rudraḥ paśubhyo mitraḥ satyo varuṇo dharmapatīnām
verses.en: Savitar quicken thee for sway of rulers, Agni of householders, of the trees Soma, Brihaspati of Speech, for lordship Indra, Rudra for cattle, Mitra for true-speaking, Varuna for the sway of Law's protectors.

verses.sa: इमं देवा असपत्नं सुवध्वं महते क्षत्राय महते ज्यैष्ठ्याय महते जानराज्यायेन्द्रस्येन्द्रियाय। इमममुष्य पुत्रममुष्यै पुत्रमस्यै विश एष वोऽमी राजा सोमोऽस्माकं ब्राह्मणानां राजा॥
verses.tr: imaṃ devā asapatnaṃ suvadhvaṃ mahate kṣatrāya mahate jyaiṣṭhyāya mahate jānarājyāyendrasyendriyāya imamamuṣya putramamuṣyai putramasyai viśa eṣa vo'mī rājā somo'smākaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ rājā
verses.en: Gods, quicken him that none may be his rival, for mighty domination, mighty lordship. Him, son of Such-a-man and Such-a-woman, of tribe. This is your King, ye Tribesmen. Soma is Lord and King of us the Brahmans.
